title: The Nyman–Beurling equivalent form for the Riemann hypothesis
read_scope: Introduction and §5 pp6–7, especially Question4; middle Hardy-space proof not audited.
main_result: Question4 p7 explicitly asks whether RH implies convergence for the fixed logarithmic Selberg coefficient array in the full critical-line norm. Question2 concerns arbitrary discrete arrays and Question3 unsmoothed Möbius sums.
limitations: The fixed-array question is not the discrete closure theorem. The paper predates Báez-Duarte’s solution of the arbitrary-array closure question.

title: On the Balazard-Saias criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis
read_scope: Printed pp1–6: definitions, Proposition1, Theorem1 statement and Remarks1–2; proof of uniform convergence in remaining pages not read.
main_result: Prop1 p2 identifies the critical-line norm of ζV_N/s with the reciprocal-fractional-part norm of W_N(u)=Σ b_n{nu}/n. Theorem1 p5 states unconditional uniform convergence to −sin(2πu)/π. Remark1 pp5–6 gives the small-u contribution (Σ b_n)²/N.
limitations: Uniform convergence does not imply the weighted norm convergence at u=0. A reported Conrey–Farmer separation-conditional result is cited as in preparation rather than proved in this source.

title: Sur un critère de Báez-Duarte pour l’hypothèse de Riemann
venue: International Journal of Number Theory6(4) (2010),883–903; arXiv manuscript inspected
version: arXiv header v1 9December2008; body prints8November2018, discrepancy recorded
read_scope: Printed pp1–5: main theorem, full Proposition1 proof and Proposition2–3 statements; later Soundararajan-based technical proof not audited.
main_result: Under RH, optimized d_N²≪δ(loglogN)^(5/2+δ)(logN)^(-1/2). Propositions 1–3 prove this through coefficients μ(n)n^(-ε), with ε=25(loglogN)^(5/2+δ)/sqrt(logN).
limitations: The source supplies an admissible shifted-array upper bound and hence bounds the infimum. It does not give the same bound for the fixed logarithmic Selberg family.

title: On an analytic estimate in the theory of the Riemann zeta function and a theorem of Báez-Duarte
venue: Acta Cientifica Venezolana54(3) (2003),210–215; arXiv preprint inspected
read_scope: Printed pp1–5: Theorems 1.3–1.4, §2 proof of discrete criterion and §3 ratio estimate. Later square-integrability/causality equivalences not fully inspected.
main_result: Theorem1.3 underRH bounds ζ(s)/ζ(s+A) on Re(s)=1/2 uniformly forA≥0. Section2 uses fixedε>0 and N→∞ thenε↓0 to reconstruct discrete closure.
limitations: Two-parameter convergence does not authorize settingε=0 at finiteN or replacing shifted coefficients by a prescribed logarithmic array.
